correctness.rationale: Exact Sherman–Morrison normalizes single-coefficient exposure to a monotone affine segment. For dimension at most two, cancellation of the common adjugate denominator again yields a monotone affine line, so covariance PSD forbids any strict interior maximum. The explicit three-sector two-edge nilpotent matrix has rational risk high–low–high–low–high at 0,10,100,1000,10000, proving at least two strict minima and one strict maximum by analyticity. Independent exact-fraction computations replayed using standalone package verify.py. This establishes the minimal sector/link boundaries with stated quantifiers.

value.rationale: A sharp structural two-axis cutoff (one varying link and at most two sectors) for the existence of an interior concentration-risk peak, together with an exact two-link/three-sector construction exhibiting multiple extrema, is directly motivated by input-output shock propagation and is not a routine isolated parameter evaluation. Strict global obstructions and simultaneous minimality supply reusable mathematical insight, not empirical claims.
